evidence_level: Real Muse content; actual local SSE client disconnect, real service process restart, and recovery of the original operation
audit_scope: Read-only audit of the originally designated seven T5 receipts plus the explicitly authorized persisted post-recovery snapshot. The original pre-restart receipt was re-read for in-memory identity comparison. No network requests, process control, test reruns, account files or Cookie files were accessed.
application_version_note: Parent agent reports application unchanged at the specified test SHA; this limited audit did not inspect Git or application source.

lock_release_evidence.interpretation: The existing protected account maintenance API successfully completed. Its application contract acquires both GEN_LOCK capacity and the account maintenance lease; this is an indirect behavioral observation of acquisition, not a direct read of internal lock variables.

restart_persistence.process_evidence_source: Actual process observations recorded by the parent agent in the added persisted-store snapshot; the auditor did not independently monitor the OS

identity_comparison.note: The added persisted-store snapshot was taken after recovery and browser fallback T6. Its original operation account/session/VM/session-key values and stored session node were compared directly to the pre-restart receipt in memory. No original identifiers are copied.

recovery.historical_metadata_note: The authoritative final state and delivery are completed and the recovery API returned ok:true. Historical cancellation fields remain as prior-operation metadata. The parent checked that the current operation UI renders state, not the historical error field; no business-code change was made.
recovery.snapshot_phase: Persisted local state after original-operation recovery and browser fallback T6; T6 did not add a protocol operation or session

evidence: One recorded T5 generation POST attempt
Same original operation/account/session/VM identity through recovery
Exact persisted operation ID set is unchanged before restart and after recovery/T6 (8 operations)
Stored node independently unchanged in the added post-recovery session snapshot

not_proven: VM sleep/wake; preserved VM identity is a different property

account_context.origin: Existing Muse account from the live account pool, reused for this run with explicit human authorization reported by the parent agent
account_context.isolation: The local application data is isolated; the account is reused, not a newly dedicated account
